name: python-text
title: Python text badge
description: A word in a rounded badge that slides up and fades in, drawn by a small Python program instead of layers: the example of a component backend (spec/components.md, "Backends"). Standard library only; it uses Pillow for the letters when asked and installed.

text.description: The word or two, shown upper-cased: A-Z, 0-9, space and .,!?-:'%+/

size.description: Letter height in pixels of the 1920x1080 design canvas.

y.description: Vertical center of the badge, design pixels.

enter.description: Seconds the badge takes to slide up 40 design pixels and fade in; 0 just appears.

pillow.description: Draw the letters with Pillow's default font when Pillow is installed (else the built-in 5x7 pixel font).
